source_text: 过去，拥有一辆私家车对大部分中国人而言是件奢侈的事。如今，私家车在中国随处可见。汽车成了人们生活 中不可或缺的一部分，他们不仅开车上下班，还经常驾车出游。有些城市的汽车增长速度过快，以至于交通拥堵和 停车位不足的问题日益严峻，这些城市的市政府不得不出台新规，限制上路汽车的数量。由于空气污染日益严重， 现在越来越多的人选择购买新能源汽车，中国政府也采取了一些措施，支持新能源汽车的发展。
reference_translation: In the past, owning a private car was a luxury for most Chinese people. Nowadays, private cars can be seen everywhere in China. Cars have become an indispensable part of people's lives. They not only drive to and from work but also often go on trips by car. In some cities, the growth rate of cars is so rapid that the problems of traffic congestion and insufficient parking spaces are becoming increasingly severe. The municipal governments of these cities have to introduce new regulations to limit the number of cars on the road. Due to the increasingly serious air pollution, more and more people are now choosing to buy new energy vehicles, and the Chinese government has also taken some measures to support the development of new energy vehicles.
